name: berlin52: against the nearest neighbour and the optimum
lesson: A plain genetic algorithm on 52 cities stays far from the optimum, 7,542, and the greedy nearest-neighbour tour (8,980, 19.1 % over the optimum) is not easy to beat.
lookFor: With this seed Run until stop pauses at generation 500, the limit, at 8,794: 16.6 % over the optimum and 2.1 % under the nearest-neighbour tour, which the best tour first beats at generation 423 (it was 37.6 % over at generation 200 and 25.8 % at 300). Over seeds 1 to 30 the median gap after 500 generations is 15.0 %, 22 of the 30 runs end under the nearest-neighbour tour (none does after 300 generations) and none reaches the optimum. Turn on Optimal tour in the route map to see where the best tour differs from it.
